key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:0FDA
name: setup_blit_descriptor_fields

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:109A
name: setup_blitter_masks_and_modulos
description: Waits for the blitter, enables blitter DMA, sets the first and last word masks to all ones, clears the A, B and D modulo registers, and loads the C data register with an alternating pattern.

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:10C4
name: update_top_bit_from_flag
description: Calls two helpers, then updates the top bit of the byte at the address register: it clears the bit when the preceding byte's low flag is set, and otherwise sets it unless bit six is already set.

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:10D2

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:111C
name: start_disk_sync_dma_read

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:1192
name: write_adkcon_conditional_bit

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:11C0
name: set_ciab_shadow_all_ones
description: Sets the CIAB port shadow byte to all ones and then calls two helper routines.

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:11DA
name: update_table_entry_with_delay
description: Reads a 16-bit entry from a table chosen by an index in the frame. If the entry is negative it returns through a helper; otherwise it repeats a helper call as many times as the difference between two shifted fields, stores the new value into the table entry and returns zero.

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:122E
name: poll_port_bit_clear_entry
description: Polls a bit of the CIAA port shadow for up to a fixed number of passes, calling a helper each time. When the bit reads clear it zeroes the matching table entry and returns zero; otherwise it returns a fixed error code.

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:124E

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:128E
name: store_ciab_port_value

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:129A
name: compute_ciab_bit_mask
description: Computes a port B shadow value with one bit cleared, chosen by an index from the frame, and also clears bit two when a stored table word has its low bit set. Returns the result with the input register.

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:12CE
name: wait_ciab_timer_expired

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:12E2
name: start_ciab_timer_if_idle

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY](Disk 2 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2E00 to $001400 (5120 bytes):0:12F0
name: write_ciab_timer_registers
description: Writes three timer control values to the CIAB control and timer registers in sequence.

name: return_immediately_stub
description: Performs no work and returns straight away.

name: store_four_row_pointers
description: Computes the start address of a row from a stored index at 160 bytes per row, then stores four pointers spaced 40 bytes apart into a table, together with an inverted nibble value.

name: initialise_copper_and_interrupts
description: Clears the sixteen colour registers, sets the CIA interrupt control and the interrupt vector, programs the interrupt-enable and DMA registers, installs a copper list pointer and strobes the copper jump.

name: swap_longwords_and_reset_slot
description: Calls a helper, zeroes the third longword of a buffer, swaps its first two longwords, then calls another helper.

name: update_input_state_bytes
description: Updates two input state bytes from helper reads, sets the top bit of each when its flag is clear, increments a tick counter, runs an optional callback when one is set, and returns a value with the top byte set.

name: read_joystick_ports_state
description: Reads the mouse and joystick port movement registers through helpers, sets the top bit of each state byte when the matching flag is clear, increments a tick counter and runs an optional callback when present.

name: advance_sound_sequence_tick
description: On each tick, when the active flag bit is set, counts down a delay. When the delay expires it reads the next entries from a list and applies their fields to the playing channels.

name: copy_words_with_stride_four
description: Copies a run of 16-bit words from the source pointer into a destination that advances four bytes per word, starting two bytes into the destination buffer.

name: init_sequence_player_state
description: Stores the source pointer, destination pointer and length in the player state, clears the step counter, and sets the initial repeat and enable fields.

name: read_flag_low_bit
description: Returns the low bit of a global flag byte as a byte value.

name: wait_volatile_field_then_return
description: Loops on a memory field comparison and returns the data register unchanged. The decompiled loop condition never changes, so this is a busy wait on a value that changes outside the code.

name: mix_bits_into_packed_pair
description: Mixes bits from two input words using masks and XOR, shifting and recombining them into a six-byte result whose bits are rearranged.

name: compute_sprite_corner_positions
description: Adds the offsets in the data registers to the first two words of a record and stores the sums. When a flag is set it also stores a second pair of sums from later record words, otherwise it stores a fixed sentinel value.

name: reset_sentinel_fields_then_call
description: When a status bit is set, writes a sentinel value into two fields of the frame record, then calls two helper routines.

name: write_four_buffer_row_pattern
description: Writes a fill byte into the same position of four parallel buffers, then writes values derived from the data register into the next row of each buffer.

name: wait_then_reset_copper_pointer
description: Calls helpers in a loop until a status value reads zero, clears a field in the frame record, and writes the copper list pointer register and strobes the copper jump.

name: advance_wrapping_frame_counter
description: Calls two helpers, then advances a global counter each time a record field is a multiple of eight, wrapping back to one after ten.

name: copy_tile_into_four_planes
description: Computes source and destination addresses from a tile position, then copies twenty-two rows of four longwords from tile data into four bitplanes spaced 40 bytes apart.

name: cycle_animation_frame_index
description: Counts down a hold timer. While it runs the frame index is zeroed and zero is returned; once it has elapsed the index advances and wraps from six back to one, and the frame index or masked status bit is returned.

name: select_threshold_state_byte
description: Returns early when two record fields are zero. Otherwise it looks up a table byte selected by an index and compares a data byte against threshold bytes, storing the chosen value in a state word.

name: dispatch_state_handler_or_copy
description: When a record field is zero it calls a handler selected from a table by another field. Otherwise it copies two record words to their backup slots.

name: copy_two_record_words
description: Copies two 16-bit fields of a record into two other fields of the same record.

name: update_scroll_camera_position
description: Clamps the view position, derived from the player record and level bounds, to 16-pixel tile boundaries, then computes the visible tile column and row range for the current scroll step.

name: init_countdown_and_clear
description: Stores a countdown value of fifty into one record field and clears two other counter fields.

name: advance_bcd_countdown_timer
description: When a run flag is set, advances a frame counter. At the limit it resets the counter and steps a BCD-coded countdown held in two record bytes, adjusting each digit with decimal correction and calling helpers to update the display.

name: reset_when_bcd_limit_reached
description: Calls a helper while a BCD counter is under the threshold of thirty. When the counter reaches 99 in BCD, it clears the run flag and the counter.

name: reset_record_state_fields
description: Clears three state bytes and calls a helper, sets an active flag, clears several counters in the record, and copies a stored value into the countdown field.

name: find_overlapping_record
description: Scans up to a fixed number of 144-byte records for one whose active flag is set and whose position range covers a given point. It stores the matching record pointer and returns one, or zero when none match.

name: lookup_tile_nibble_value
description: Converts the record position to tile coordinates by shifting four bits, looks up a tile byte in a map table, and returns its low nibble, or zero when the byte's low five bits are ten or more.

name: allocate_object_slot
description: Searches a pool of 144-byte entries for a free one, returning minus one when none is free. Otherwise it fills the entry with the given X and Y positions, a pointer and cleared state fields.

name: update_three_object_tables
description: Clears a pointer field, then walks three tables of 144-byte entries. It calls a helper for each active entry in the first two tables, and in the third it toggles the status bits and calls a helper for entries whose flags match.

name: process_eight_active_entries
description: Walks eight 144-byte table entries and calls a helper for each one whose active bit is set.

name: cull_object_outside_view
description: Checks an object's position against a window around the view. Objects outside the window are deactivated, and a saved value is written back when one is held; objects inside have their previous position updated.

name: step_object_animation_script
description: Advances an object's animation script: it reads the next frame entry from a list, treats negative markers as loop or end codes, and counts frames down between steps.

name: find_bounded_entry_table_a
description: When a status bit is set, scans sixteen 144-byte entries for an active one with a particular flag whose bounds contain the reference point, and records it as the current target.

name: find_bounded_entry_table_b
description: Performs the same bounds search as its neighbour, but over eight entries of a second table.

name: consume_bounded_entry_on_hit
description: When a status bit is set, looks through eight entries for an active one whose bounds contain the reference point, reduces a counter by two, clears that entry's active flag, and records it as the target.

name: check_object_hits_table_entries
description: For an active object, checks eight table entries for a flagged one whose bounds overlap the object's box, then reduces a counter, clears the entry's flag and links the entry to the object.

name: resolve_overlapping_object_pairs
description: Nested scan: for each active entry in one table, tests every active entry of a second table for bounds overlap and handles each overlapping pair through a helper.

name: match_objects_by_type_codes
description: Returns early when a status field is set. Otherwise it pairs active entries from two tables whose bounds overlap and whose type codes are not an excluded pair, and handles each match through a helper.

name: trigger_entries_in_bounds
description: When a status bit is set, scans nineteen entries for active ones whose bounds contain the reference point, copies a saved position into each, clears a counter, and calls a helper for the first hit.

name: trigger_first_bounded_entry
description: Scans ten entries for the first active one whose flag bit is set and whose bounds contain the reference point, resets its counter and calls a helper, then stops.

name: compute_entry_hit_offset
description: Clears two pending fields and a status bit, then scans sixteen entries for one with a particular flag whose bounds contain the reference point, and stores an offset computed from that entry's position fields.

name: check_records_inside_window
description: Walks an array of 288-byte records and, for each active record whose position lies inside a 768 by 384 window, calls a helper with the record index. Stores in a result field whether any record matched.

name: notify_records_in_window
description: Like its neighbour, walks 288-byte records and calls a helper for active records inside the same 768 by 384 window, but passes a different argument to the helper.

name: clear_and_load_table_block
description: Clears 1280 longwords, then copies rows of data from three source arrays into the cleared block at fixed strides.

name: draw_seven_digit_value
description: Rotates a 32-bit value one nibble at a time across seven digits, skipping leading zeros, and calls a helper to draw each non-zero digit. It selects the leading helper from two flag fields first.

name: draw_digit_nibbles_from_field
description: Calls a helper, then rotates a 32-bit field one nibble at a time, skipping leading zero nibbles and calling a helper for each remaining digit, then calls a closing helper.

name: draw_digit_nibbles_after_setup
description: Calls two helpers, then runs the same nibble loop as its neighbour over a 32-bit field, drawing each non-leading digit and calling a closing helper.

name: update_slot_records_or_clear
description: Calls a helper, then either clears thirty-two slot records or updates slot fields from the current frame state when a flag is set, calling helpers as it goes.

name: copy_pattern_table_into_slots
description: Copies a set of 16-bit words from a source table into a grid of slots spaced 40 bytes apart, filling four rows of the slot block.

name: fill_slot_grid_with_value
description: Writes a single 32-bit value and its low word into the same grid of slots spaced 40 bytes apart, covering the whole slot block.

name: scatter_table_bytes_to_planes
description: Copies bytes from a table block chosen by an index into destination offsets 40 bytes apart, repeating across several rows of four planes.

name: scatter_table_bytes_selected_row
description: Selects one of two table blocks from a stored value, then copies its bytes into destination offsets 40 bytes apart in the same way as its neighbour.

name: store_constant_bytes_to_planes
description: Calls four helpers, then stores bytes read from fixed RAM locations into destination offsets spaced 40 bytes apart, writing a repeating pattern across rows.

name: call_two_helpers_in_order
description: Calls two helper routines in sequence and returns.

name: fill_sixteen_block_positions
description: Writes one 32-bit value into sixteen fixed positions of a block, spaced by 40-byte and 160-byte row offsets.

name: run_frame_update_helpers
description: Calls a fixed set of helper routines in order, calling two of them only when a status field is zero.

name: draw_visible_records_in_view
description: Loops over active records and, for each one whose position relative to the view offset lies inside a screen-sized window, stores its coordinates and calls helpers to draw it.

name: init_object_by_type_switch
description: Sets a fixed size and frame fields, then switches on a five-bit type code to choose the handler setup. Part of the decompiled tail is undecodable bytes, so only the setup is described.

name: initialise_actor_then_run_loop
description: Sets fixed velocity, timer and size fields in an actor record, stores a handler address, sets flags from the record's type byte, then loops calling helpers that run the actor's per-frame behaviour.

name: initialise_actor_inner_wait_loop
description: Sets the same fixed actor fields and handler address as its neighbour, then runs an outer loop with an inner wait loop that polls a helper before each step.

name: initialise_actor_bit_gated_loop
description: Sets the same fixed actor fields as its neighbours, then runs a loop that clears a status bit in a shared byte before polling a helper each pass.

name: initialise_actor_and_return
description: Sets the same fixed actor fields, then waits while a field is nonzero, zeroes counters, calls helpers and returns.

name: tick_actor_countdown_handler
description: Each pass calls helpers and decrements a countdown field. When it reaches zero it calls the handler pointer stored in the record and returns; otherwise it resets counters and polls a helper until it reports a nonzero value.

name: tick_actor_countdown_alt
description: Counts a countdown field down like its neighbour and calls the stored handler at zero, but polls a helper inside a wait loop before setting the timer.

name: idle_loop_with_sentinel
description: Calls a helper once, then loops forever writing a sentinel value to a field and calling a helper each pass. Control does not return from this routine.

name: spin_forever_writing_sentinel
description: Loops forever, writing a sentinel value into a record field and calling a helper on each pass. It never returns.

name: tick_actor_countdown_flagged
description: Like the countdown routines beside it, decrements a countdown and calls the stored handler at zero, but clears a status bit and sets a flag word before its wait loop.

name: tick_actor_countdown_pointer
description: Uses the same countdown pattern as its neighbours: it decrements a countdown, calls the stored handler pointer at zero, and otherwise polls helpers and a state byte in a wait loop.

name: wait_state_bit_arm_timer
description: Polls a helper while toggling a state bit, leaves the loop when a second state bit is set, then arms a countdown of twenty-five and stores the handler pointer.

name: poll_state_then_arm_countdown
description: Enters the same state-bit wait as its neighbour, sets the callback and state bit, and when the second bit is set arms a countdown and counts it down until the handler runs.

name: arm_countdown_and_run_handler
description: Arms a countdown of twenty-five with a handler pointer, then decrements it while polling a helper, calling the handler when the countdown reaches zero.

name: decrement_countdown_then_wait
description: Decrements a countdown field, calls the handler pointer at zero, and otherwise waits in a loop polling helpers until a state byte clears.

name: poll_state_flags_until_set
description: Waits in a loop that polls two helpers and toggles a state bit, leaves when a second bit is set, then arms a countdown and handler pointer.

name: run_state_countdown_step
description: Loops over a state byte: while a flag bit is clear it resets a counter and calls a helper. Once the flag bit is set it arms a countdown and calls the handler pointer when the countdown reaches zero.

name: arm_countdown_clear_state_bit
description: Arms a countdown with a flagged value and a handler pointer, decrements it and calls the handler at zero, then clears a state bit and polls helpers in a wait loop.

name: countdown_then_poll_state
description: Decrements a countdown and calls the handler at zero, then clears a state bit and polls a helper in a wait loop before storing the next handler.

name: clear_state_then_poll_handler
description: Clears a state bit, resets two counters, then runs a wait loop that stores the handler pointer and polls a helper until it reports a nonzero value, toggling state bits as it goes.

name: reset_actor_status_bits
description: Clears a state bit, sets and toggles a status bit, sets a field to four and calls helpers in sequence, sets another status bit, repeats the field setup, then clears the record's status word.

name: reset_actor_status_sequence
description: Runs the same status-bit and field-setting sequence as its neighbour, with more helper calls, and finishes by clearing the record's status word.

name: write_tile_row_bytes
description: Computes a byte address in a tile buffer from the actor's position in tiles and a row stride, then writes four identical bytes and one more byte there.

name: loop_status_bit_forever
description: Sets a field to 225 and copies a record field into another, then loops forever setting a status bit, toggling it when a stored mode is not the expected value, and calling a helper each pass.

name: dispatch_by_record_state
description: Stores a fixed constant in a record field, then calls the handler selected from a table by the record's state word.

name: initialise_actor_polling_loop
description: Advances an actor's position by four, sets fixed timer and size fields, sets a flag, selects a handler from a table by the state word, then polls helpers in a loop until one reports a stop code, and arms a timer.

name: copy_position_on_code_match
description: When a flag bit is clear and a helper returns a code that passes a chain of byte comparisons, copies two longword positions from the record into the state block.

name: initialise_record_defaults
description: Clears flag bits and zeroes several record fields, sets a longword default and a timer of fifty-nine, calls a helper, then sets two state fields to their starting values.

name: adjust_counter_from_input_codes
description: Sets a status flag, then when a control bit is set it reads two helper codes and adds or subtracts two from a counter, clearing the status flag when a matching code is found.

name: step_position_on_input_codes
description: When an enable bit is set, checks a mode value and a position against a target and reads helper codes, moving the position by minus two on each matching code. A second flag is handled before returning.

name: call_three_helper_routines
description: Calls three unnamed helper routines and an empty stub. The decompiler timed out, so this description uses only the call list and instruction count.

name: initialise_tagged_actor_record
description: Stores a two-character type tag, sets flag bits, a limit of 9999, a handler pointer, negative sixteen position fields and a size, then calls a helper and clears the flags. The record fields are taken from the listing.

name: clear_record_longword
description: Writes zero to the 32-bit field of the record it is given and returns. The listing also references a short text tag and makes three calls to unnamed helpers.

name: call_two_unnamed_routines
description: Makes two calls to unnamed helper routines in an eleven-instruction body. The decompiler timed out, so the description uses only the call list.

name: invoke_pair_of_unnamed_routines
description: Calls a pair of unnamed helper routines in a twenty-five-instruction body. The decompiler timed out, so no further behaviour is stated.

name: chain_two_unnamed_routine_calls
description: Chains two calls to unnamed helper routines in a thirteen-instruction body. The decompiler timed out, so the description is limited to the call list.

name: wrap_two_unnamed_calls
description: Makes two calls to unnamed helper routines in an eight-instruction body. The decompiler timed out, so no further behaviour is stated.

name: advance_frame_counter_on_flag
description: If a control bit is set and the actor's flag bit is clear, sets that bit and advances a counter that wraps back to zero after four steps. Otherwise it clears the actor's flag bit.

name: setup_audio_channel_dma
description: Touches the location and length registers of audio channels 0 and 1 and the DMA control register in a twenty-two-instruction body. The decompiler timed out, so nothing beyond the register list is stated.

key: Alien 3 (1992)(Virgin)[cr PDY](Disk 1 of 2).adf bytes 14336-14848 (code never loaded by a reference run):0:0000
name: copy_matching_record_field
description: When the zero flag is set and two record words hold the values two and one, copies a 16-bit field from the record into a global variable. The file notes this region is never loaded at runtime.
